headline: US Camp David Summit Addresses Iran, Houthi Threats Amid Escalation
subheadline: Houthi strike on Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh forced closure of airspace while Saudi airstrikes hit Sanaa and Amran governorate.
lede: US national security officials convened at Camp David to discuss next steps against Iran and Houthis, recalling a similar meeting that preceded previous escalations. Houthi forces attacked Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Riyadh, producing heavy smoke and forcing closure of the city's airspace, while Saudi airstrikes targeted Amran governorate and the capital Sanaa. The US Treasury Secretary announced that Iran will have zero oil shipments at sea this week for the first time in history, noting that the US facilitated 1.1 billion barrels through the Strait of Hormuz. Israel struck the Gaza apartment of Hamas leader Al-Amoudi, with casualties reported but his fate unconfirmed, as Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir declared the entire West Bank belongs to Israel and threatened to topple the Palestinian Authority.

sections.title: Russian Missile Drone Attack Hits Multiple Ukrainian Cities
sections.body: Russian forces launched a large-scale combined missile-drone barrage overnight, firing at least four Kh-101/555 cruise missiles from the Chernihiv region toward Kyiv, Pryluky, Vyshhorod, and Brovary, while massed Shahed/Geran-5 drones approached from six axes including the Black Sea, Bryansk, Chernihiv, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, and Kyiv reservoir. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, and Odesa regions, and a drone strike damaged Kyiv's Northern Bridge, blocking traffic and damaging roadway and trolleybus lines. In response, Ukrainian precision strikes hit a Russian command post near Novaya Tavolzhanka in Belgorod, a river crossing near Novoocheretuvate, a repair base near Hromivka in Kherson, and an ammo depot near Voznesenivka in Belgorod. The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed control of the village of Novaya Kazachya in the Kharkiv region, while DeepState mapping confirmed further gains near Kotlyne.

sections.title: Houthi Attack on Saudi Aramco Facilities in Riyadh
sections.body: Houthi forces attacked Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Riyadh, causing heavy smoke and leading to the closure of airspace over the city. In response, Saudi airstrikes targeted Amran governorate and the capital Sanaa, with footage of strikes circulating. The US Treasury Secretary announced that Iran will have zero oil shipments at sea this week for the first time in history, while the US facilitated 1.1 billion barrels through the Strait of Hormuz. Israel struck the Gaza apartment of Hamas leader Al-Amoudi, with casualties reported but his fate unconfirmed, and Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir declared the entire West Bank belongs to Israel, threatening to topple the Palestinian Authority.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The convergence of a high-level US Camp David meeting, Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure, and Israel's decapitation strike in Gaza indicates a coordinated escalation axis. Iran's unprecedented oil export halt suggests the maritime blockade is achieving strategic effect, potentially forcing Iranian retaliation. Ben-Gvir's annexation rhetoric risks igniting West Bank unrest while the IDF operates in Gaza and Lebanon.
